Resolves #20198

An id-less history read before the first route now returns an empty array without registering an `undefined` window. The first real window remains the default for later reads; selected-window stacks retain their existing identity and behavior.

Change class: `restoration`. `agent-preflight`: not hosted here; the Engine's JSDoc, size and unit checks cover this change.
Evidence: L2 (production HashHistory in the unit runtime) → L2 required (the reported cold-read/state regression). Residual: none.

Micro-review eligible: contained repair — one guard in the existing history owner; no new API, config or representation.

## AC Evidence
No structured ACs on #20198.

| Expected behavior | Evidence |
|---|---|
| Cold reads do not register a phantom window | The new cold-read regression exercises `getStack/getCount/first/second/getAt` and asserts no stored stack. |
| Later id-less reads find the first real window | A cold read followed by pushes to two windows preserves the first entry, count and actual stack reference. |
| Existing history behavior stays intact | Existing event, duplicate, trimming, window-isolation and identity tests remain. |

## Deltas from ticket
None substantive. The reproducer and the existing tests from PR #20197 supplied the starting evidence; the contributor's reported expected behavior is preserved.

## Test Evidence
Before the implementation change, both new regressions failed: `stacks` contained `"undefined"`, and the later default read missed the first entry. The same regressions pass with the guard. Routine coverage runs in CI.

None — no deployment or data migration is required for this source repair.
